pairs.reason: Being ruined by medical bills is a shared problem with how care is paid for, while not being able to see a doctor is a personal problem of getting care at all, so both belong, linked across pages.
Having no savings for any surprise bill is personal, while fearing that illness itself could ruin you points at how healthcare is paid for, so keep both and link them.
